defaultPrompt: Use the ECC engineering workflow to plan, implement, test, and independently review this change: describe the goal and constraints first.
Review this code for correctness, security, maintainability, and missing tests. Separate confirmed defects from hypotheses.
Help me debug this issue with research-first, evidence-driven steps and a regression test.
interface.longDescription: A focused engineering workflow companion inspired by the public ECC repository. It guides research-first development, risk-aware planning, test-driven implementation, independent review, verification, security checks, and concise learning capture. It does not install or execute ECC's external hooks, agents, scripts, or runtime.

name: ecc-engineering-companion
description: A practical agentic engineering workflow companion inspired by ECC: research first, plan, test, implement, review, verify, and retain useful lessons.
